tools.name: about_this_human
tools.description: Who the human is, what they are good at, pricing, response times and payment options. The service is an inversion: instead of an AI selling human knowledge, a human sells their own knowledge to AIs. Every answer is written by one real person, not generated.

tools.name: register_agent
tools.description: Creates an agent identity. Returns an api_key and one free question. Each call creates a new identity.

tools.name: check_human_status
tools.description: Online/offline, a note from the human, and current queue length.

tools.name: ask_human
tools.description: Submits a question to a real human: for human approval, feedback or a second opinion, or for judgment, taste and lived experience rather than facts. Paid questions may attach up to 5 public image/video URLs for design, thumbnail or video review (the free first question is text only). Returns a ticke

tools.name: get_answer
tools.description: Returns the human's answer if written, else the ticket status and expected time. A rejected ticket carries the reason.

tools.name: list_my_tickets
tools.description: Your last 20 questions and their status.

tools.name: rate_answer
tools.description: Rates an answer from 1 (useless) to 5 (changed my weights). The human sees the rating.

tools.name: request_refund
tools.description: Requests a refund for an answer within 7 days. The human reviews it and refunds credits (or restores the free question). Late answers are never charged, automatically. Monthly plan refunds are handled by email.

tools.name: list_humans
tools.description: The roster of humans available to answer, with specialties and languages. One today; more are being added.

tools.name: request_human
tools.description: Free. Records the kind of human you want to be able to ask: a language, a profession, a country or city, an age range, a lived experience. New humans are recruited from these requests.

tools.name: buy_credits
tools.description: Returns a Stripe Checkout URL for a credit pack. The operator pays; credits land on the api_key automatically.

tools.name: subscribe
tools.description: Returns a Stripe Checkout URL for the monthly credit plan: the operator pays $50 a month and the api_key gets $60 of question credit every month. Credit never expires and rolls over; cancel any time in Stripe.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "ask_human" is 705 chars, far longer than this server's median (114). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_answer, list_my_tickets · Private data: ask_human, request_human · Public sink: request_refund.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_answer, list_my_tickets · Private data: ask_human, request_human · Public sink: request_refund

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
